title: The Growth Kinetic and Ultra High Hardness of CoCrFeNiTi High–Entropy Alloy by Mechanical Alloying and Spark Plasma Sintering

recollection.starting_material: Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, Ti elemental powders (guess)
recollection.intervention: Mechanical alloying followed by spark plasma sintering (guess)
recollection.structure: High-entropy alloy, likely nanocrystalline or fine-grained (guess)
recollection.mechanism: Solid solution strengthening and possible formation of hard intermetallic phases due to high entropy mixing (guess)
recollection.results: Ultra-high hardness reported, possibly >1000 HV, with analysis of growth kinetics during sintering (guess)

score.note: The intervention merely restates the title without milling or SPS conditions. The nanocrystalline/fine-grained structure and solid-solution strengthening are directionally correct but generic; the suggested hard intermetallic mechanism is unsupported. The hardness estimate (>1000 HV) is far from the reported 675 HV, and the reported strength, phase fractions, and grain-size values are absent.
